description: A PHP class collection 'StringUtils' providing static methods for string manipulation, including delimiter-based replacements, markup-safe explosion, regex escaping, and a custom explode iterator, along with several helper classes for replacements and iterators.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for advanced string manipulation.

classes.name: Replacer
classes.description: Base class for creating replacers used in regex replacements.

classes.name: RegexlikeReplacer
classes.description: Replaces regex matches with specified strings, mimicking preg_replace behavior.

classes.name: DoubleReplacer
classes.description: Performs secondary replacements within replacement strings, replacing specific substrings.

classes.name: HashtableReplacer
classes.description: Performs replacements based on a hash table lookup with pattern matching.

classes.name: ReplacementArray
classes.description: Manages replacement mappings with lazy FSS resource support, falling back to strtr.

classes.name: ExplodeIterator
classes.description: Iterator implementation for lazy string splitting without excessive memory overhead.

methods.name: hungryDelimiterReplace
methods.description: Efficient delimiter replacement avoiding O(N^2) complexity, suitable for small texts.

methods.name: delimiterReplaceCallback
methods.description: Delimiter-based replacement using a callback, handles nested delimiters with performance considerations.

methods.name: delimiterReplace
methods.description: Wrapper around delimiterReplaceCallback, providing regex-based delimiter replacements.

methods.name: explodeMarkup
methods.description: Splits strings by a separator ignoring separators inside HTML-like tags.

methods.name: escapeRegexReplacement
methods.description: Escapes a string to be safely used as a replacement in preg_replace.

methods.name: explode
methods.description: Limited-memory explode that returns an iterator for large strings.
